opening_message:
Ticket 1: Edward Fleming (employee ID E042) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E042.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Edward Fleming (E042) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write access, and admin only if their role owns the system (Source Code is owned by Engineer). Recommended level: write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security record for E042: contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training (never admin). Requested write, but max for this employee is read. Recommended level: read.
reason: Edward Fleming (E042) requested write access to Source Code. The Security record (Note 2) states E042 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training (never admin). Since this employee has only basic training, the maximum allowed level is read. The requested write exceeds this maximum, so I grant the maximum of read.
